'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Sectarianism and minorities in the Syrian civil war]]
***[[2025 massacres of Syrian Druze]], [[Southern Syria clashes (April 2025–present)|Southern Syria clashes]] 
****The [[Syrian Observatory for Human Rights|Syrian Observatory of Human Rights]] reports that nine [[Extrajudicial killing|field executions]] were conducted against members of the [[Druze in Syria|Syrian Druze]] community amid an outbreak of [[Sectarianism and minorities in the Syrian civil war|sectarian clashes]]. Syrian Druze spiritual leader [[Sheikh]] [[Hikmat al-Hijri]] characterizes the killings as part of a "[[genocidal]] campaign". [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2599119/middle-east (Arab News)] [https://www.syriahr.com/9-%d8%ad%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%a7%d8%aa-%d8%a5%d8%b9%d8%af%d8%a7%d9%85-%d9%85%d9%8a%d8%af%d8%a7%d9%86%d9%8a-%d9%8892-%d9%82%d8%aa%d9%8a%d9%84%d8%a7-%d8%ae%d9%84%d8%a7%d9%84-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%a7%d8%b4%d8%aa/759406/ (SOHR)]
****[[Israeli Druze]] spiritual leader Sheikh [[Mowafaq Tarif]] appeals to [[Israel]] to intervene against ongoing massacres. [https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-852241 (''The Jerusalem Post'')] 
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Odesa strikes (2022–present)|Odesa strikes]]
***An overnight [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[drone warfare|drone attack]] on [[Odesa]], [[Ukraine]], kills two people and injures 15 others. High-rise apartments, residential homes, a supermarket and a school were among those targeted, according to [[Governor of Odesa Oblast]] [[Oleh Kiper]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-drones-damage-dwellings-infrastructure-ukraines-odesa-2025-04-30/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least ten people are killed while 37 others are injured in a [[multiple-vehicle collision]] at a [[tollbooth|toll plaza]] of the [[Subic–Clark–Tarlac Expressway]] in [[Tarlac City]], [[Philippines]]. [https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/metro/944642/12-dead-over-20-hurt-in-sctex-toll-plaza-multiple-collision/story/ (GMA Integrated News)] [https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/2057499/10-dead-in-sctex-toll-plaza-crash (''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]
*The bodies of three [[South Africa]]n police officers who had been missing for six days are found in the [[Hennops River]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cp8kejn3k10o (BBC News)]
*Seven people, including six [[Italy|Italian]] and [[China|Chinese]] nationals, are killed and at least sixteen others are injured, some severely, when a truck and a van collide and catch fire on [[U.S. Route 20]] near [[Yellowstone National Park]] in [[Idaho]], United States. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/7-killed-idaho-tour-van-truck-collide-yellowstone-rcna204491 (NBC News)] [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/idaho-crash-tour-van-pickup-collide-deaths/ (CBS News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2025 Southwest United States measles outbreak]]
**[[North America]]'s three largest [[measles]] outbreaks continue to expand, with over 2,500 confirmed cases. There have been three fatalities in the [[United States]] and one in [[Mexico]]. The outbreaks began in [[Ontario]], [[Canada]], then surged in [[Texas]] and [[New Mexico]], and have quickly escalated in [[Chihuahua (state)|Chihuahua]], [[Mexico]]. [https://apnews.com/article/measles-texas-mexico-canada-ontario-0956a30c043b030ae79bc9f67c6ce89c (AP News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[North Korea–Russia relations]]
**[[North Korea]] and [[Russia]] announce the construction of their first road link, a bridge over the [[Tumen River]]. The bridge will be a kilometer long, and will enhance cross-border travel, tourism, and the circulation of commodities. [https://apnews.com/article/north-korea-russia-bridge-troops-ukraine-3358c993c68da2dd4ab287c3fd98adba (AP News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 South Korean martial law]]
**The [[Supreme Prosecutors' Office of the Republic of Korea|prosecutors]] of [[South Korea]] [[indictment (law)|indict]] former [[President of South Korea|president]] [[Yoon Suk-yeol]] of [[abuse of power|abuse of authority]] after he declared [[martial law]] in December 2024. [https://www.dw.com/en/south-koreas-ex-president-yoon-indicted-for-abuse-of-power/a-72404283 (DW)]
*''[[Epic Games v. Apple]]''
**A [[U.S. district judge]] finds that [[Apple Inc.|Apple]] willfully violated an [[injunction]] in a case brought by [[Epic Games]]. The injunction was supposed to block Apple from [[anti-competitive]] conduct and pricing, opening the [[App Store]] up to outside payment options. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c62xv43xqq5o (BBC News)]
*[[United States government group chat leaks]]
**In the wake of the Signalgate scandal, [[Mike Waltz]] and [[Alex Nelson Wong]] resign as [[National Security Advisor (United States)|U.S. National Security Advisor]] and [[Deputy National Security Advisor]] respectively, marking the first resignations during the [[Second presidency of Donald Trump|second Trump administration]]. [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] later nominates Waltz as the [[U.S. Ambassador to the United Nations]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/trump-mike-waltz-alex-wong/ (CBS News)]
*[[M23 campaign (2022–present)]]
**Authorities in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] request the [[Senate (Democratic Republic of the Congo)|Senate]] to lift the immunity of former [[List of presidents of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|President]] [[Joseph Kabila]] to face trial on charges of supporting a rebel uprising. The [[Ministry of Justice (Democratic Republic of the Congo)|Justice Minister]] alleged that there is evidence implicating him in [[war crimes]], [[crimes against humanity]], and [[massacre]]s of peaceful civilians and military personnel. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cq5wxe10xxwo (BBC News)]
*The [[Supreme Court of Korea]] overturns the acquittal judgement of [[Democratic Party (South Korea, 2015)|Democratic Party]] presidential candidate and former leader [[Lee Jae-myung]] over violation of election law. The court orders the case to be sent back to [[High courts of South Korea|Seoul High Court]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/world/asia/south-koreas-top-court-rules-presidential-frontrunner-potentially-upen-rcna204014 (NBC News)]
*United States District Judge [[Fernando Rodriguez Jr.]] rules that [[US President]] [[Donald Trump]] cannot use the [[Alien Enemies Act]] to deport [[Venezuela]]n migrants, deeming the previous use of this power as having been improperly invoked. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cgm8r1eekd4o (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 South Korean presidential election]]
**Acting [[South Korea]]n [[President of South Korea|President]] [[Han Duck-soo]] resigns, indicating a possible run in the upcoming [[Presidential elections in South Korea|presidential election]]. [https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20250501005400315 (Yonhap)]
**[[Minister of Economy and Finance (South Korea)|Finance Minister]] [[Choi Sang-mok]], the next person in the presidential line of succession, resigns a few hours later. [https://m-en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20250501008251320 (Yonhap)]
*[[2025 United Kingdom local elections]]
**The [[United Kingdom]] holds [[local elections]], as well as a [[2025 Runcorn and Helsby by-election|parliamentary by-election]] in the [[Runcorn and Helsby (UK Parliament constituency)|Runcorn and Helsby constituency]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/crm3rl27k8lo (BBC News)]

'''Sports'''
*[[The Football Association]] bans [[Trans woman|transgender women]] from [[Women's football in England|women's football]] in [[England]] starting 1 June after amending its eligibility criteria. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cz01z4rdx4no (BBC Sport)]
